ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens, dark green to pale green leaves with ruffled edges and some wilted tips, covering most of the left and upper bowl area, moist with a matte surface, roughly 60% of the bowl footprint, piled several cm high | 90
ITEM 2 | Cubes of pale tan, matte, firm-looking solid, about 1.5 to 2 cm per side, with slightly irregular edges and no visible browning, scattered across the center and right side over the greens | 75
ITEM 3 | Thin slices of red-purple onion, translucent edges, curved rings and strips about 0.2 cm thick, scattered over the greens and near the right edge | 12
ITEM 4 | Avocado slice, pale green flesh with a slightly glossy sheen, sitting in a crescent wedge about 5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide near the right side of the bowl | 25
ITEM 5 | Thin shreds of pale yellow-green, stringy, slightly curled strands clustered among the greens near the top center, small amount | 3
